別拿錢開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
感謝您使用我們的服務。

scripts.text: Alliance Forces Post -> 5500z
scripts.translation: 聯合駐地 -> 5500z

scripts.text: Splendide Camp -> 7500z
scripts.translation: 輝煌領域營地 -> 7500z

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Don't play with money.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
別拿錢開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Don't play with money.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
別拿錢開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
感謝您使用我們的服務。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
感謝您使用我們的服務。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
... ... ... ...
Please give me some Piece of Fish.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
......
請給我一些魚塊。

scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.
It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation:
這塊岩石含有尚未鑑定的礦石。
無法開採超過上限的數量。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 沒有抓到任何東西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 魚在水裡遊動。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
你攜帶的物品過多。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Outsider?
Outsiders have been coming more frequently.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
外來者？
最近外來者越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
It seems like our superiors have permitted your entrance, so I won't stop you either.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域衛兵]
看來上級已經允許你進入了，那我也不會阻攔你。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
My name is Arc.
By the way, hmm... Can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我叫阿克。
對了，嗯......你能聽懂我說的話嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Shake my head
scripts.translation: 搖頭

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Did you just say 'Yes'?
Can't believe we understand eachother!
When did you learn our language?
What is your race called?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？你剛才說“是”嗎？
真不敢相信我們居然能互相理解！
你什麼時候學會我們的語言的？
你的種族叫什麼？

scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示戒指，並把事情經過告訴了他，包括我是如何來到這裡的...... -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
So...hmm, That's how it is...
The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
原來如此......嗯，事情是這樣的......
那個巨大沖擊和神秘爆炸的源頭......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Quite an interesting story.
That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真是有趣的故事。
原來你們人類一直在到處探索...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
現在我明白了，你不是馬努克巨人派來的。
謝謝你告訴我這些有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Oh? Is that so?
We use different languages as expected...
That's a bit frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
哦？是嗎？
看來我們果然使用不同的語言......
真讓人有些沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
By the way, you...
No, never mind...
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
對了，你......
不，算了......
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, right. {0}!
That's a strange pronunciation.
I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，對了。{0}！
這個發音真特別。
我可能會念錯，請多包涵......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
總之，我有件事想拜託你。可以嗎？

scripts.text: What favor?
scripts.translation: 什麼忙？

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 現在不行

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Um...Ah..It's...
A little...complicated...
- Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克環顧四周，確認附近沒人後，才壓低聲音繼續說。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
老實說，我很擔心一個朋友。她未經許可就離開了，說要去檢視你們的營地。從那以後她就沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
可是我不能擅離崗位去找她，因為我有責任守護存放在這裡的研究資料。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她未經許可就離開了，我甚至沒法向上級報告......那隻會讓事情變得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
想到這些我就很擔心......
事實上，我們儘量避免和馬努克巨人接觸，所以彼此都不進入對方的領地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你們的營地位於我們兩族之間的中立地帶......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果她已經靠近他們的領地，可能去了雪原......
那樣我們就更難找到她了......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
馬努克巨人可能會把這當成挑釁......不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，你是想讓我去找你的朋友，對吧？
局勢這麼複雜，你自己沒法離開崗位去找她？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Exactly!
You're quite observant.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
正是如此！
你觀察得真仔細。

scripts.text: Sure, I will do it.
scripts.translation: 當然，我會去找她。

scripts.text: Sorry, can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我幫不了你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，要找她的話，我需要更多線索。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
不用擔心......^4d4dff泰拉^000000習慣用打結的植物標記自己走過的地方。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She does it so that she won't get lost.
If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她這樣做是為了防止迷路。
如果你發現一串打結的植物，順著它們應該就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
Please, I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
找起來可能很困難，但總比什麼都不做強......
求求你了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
還有，請對其他拉斐族保密。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...
Please, find her.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
記住，{0}......這件事要保密......
拜託了，請找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It sure was an unreasonable favor...
You too were sent here to carry on a mission...
That was thoughtless of me...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
這要求確實有些過分......
你也有自己的任務要執行......
是我考慮不周......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Is that so? Of course.
You were sent here to carry on your own mission...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
是嗎？當然。
你也有自己的任務要執行......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
^4d4dff泰拉^000000習慣用植物打結來標記去過的地方。
尋找她時請留意這一點。還有，別告訴其他拉斐族她失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Do me this favor please.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}，你是唯一能幫我的人......
請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Did you find anything?
Have you found any knotted plants?
Yeah, that's the mark
that Terra leaves.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你找到什麼了嗎？
發現打結的植物了嗎？
對，那就是泰拉留下的標記。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Keep it up and find her
for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
繼續找下去，幫我找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, Well met!
What do I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，你來了！
我現在該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text: What? What happened?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: - Arc looks like he was thrown into confusion about something. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克看起來有些不知所措。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra came back!!!
but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉回來了！！！
她平安回來了！
可是她渾身是傷......

scripts.text: Covered with wounds?
scripts.translation: 渾身是傷？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She didn't even get treatment!
She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她甚至沒接受治療！
就拖著疲憊的身體把布拉迪姆帶走了！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
It happened all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她連理由都沒告訴我！
我明明攔著她，可她根本不聽！
事情發生得太突然了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!
What shoud I do now?
What do I have to do?
Terra left again and she was hurt...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！
我現在該怎麼辦？
我到底該做什麼？
泰拉又離開了，而且她受了傷......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
而我只是站在這裡......什麼也沒做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.
scripts.translation: 你有強烈的責任感

scripts.text:
[Arc]
......anyways.
I couldn't either stop her, or follow her...
What now...?
Why did she take the Bradium...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......總之。
我既沒能攔住她，也沒能跟上她......
現在該怎麼辦......？
她為什麼要拿走布拉迪姆......？

scripts.text: - You tell Arc about the Giant from the cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你把洞穴裡那名巨人的事告訴了阿克。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Is that what happened?
Bradium...is certainly a precious ore for Sapha.
They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？原來是這樣？
布拉迪姆確實是薩法族珍視的礦石。
他們會使用精煉過的布拉迪姆......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You said that a Sapha was hurt?
And its body was already stiff?
Impossible!
Terra!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你說有個薩法族受傷了？
而且身體已經僵硬了？
不可能！
泰拉！

scripts.text: - Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克突然開始收拾裝備。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你發現那名薩法族的洞穴在哪裡？
我們巡查周邊時，根本沒見過這樣的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation: 你想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Can't you see?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你還不明白嗎？
我要出去找泰拉。她帶走了布拉迪姆，這肯定和那名薩法族有關。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
scripts.translation: 你擅離職守沒關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It's.. ...
...No....
Shit, then what should I do!!

[{0}]
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去吧。只有我知道那個洞穴的確切位置。
我會去把她帶回來。
如果泰拉去了那個洞穴，我應該能找到她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們先聽泰拉把事情說完吧。
你得留在這裡守衛，對吧？
如果泰拉真的未經許可就拿走了布拉迪姆......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
上級不會坐視不管......
抱歉麻煩你了......
請去把她帶回來......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
...Please, find Terra.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真的很抱歉把你捲進這堆麻煩裡......
......請找到泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什麼？薩法村莊裡有一位受傷的拉斐族？
是泰拉嗎？！她被那些薩法族抓住了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點。我沒法確認被抓的拉斐族是不是泰拉。
而且他們似乎沒有傷害她的意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，他們在找能治療受傷拉斐族的東西......
如果我們給他們帶些藥，也許有機會確認她是誰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白你有多著急......但這是我唯一能想到的確認她身份的辦法。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會帶些療傷藥過去。如果被抓的拉斐族是泰拉，我就把她帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
..........
OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......好吧，看來這是目前我們能做的最好的事了......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
Especially for us Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你知道世界樹嗎？
沒有什麼比世界樹果實更適合治療傷口......
尤其對我們拉斐族而言......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
.Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果你有世界樹果實，就可以用它治療那位拉斐族......
世界樹是生命之樹，它的根系與世間萬物相連。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I have...
...only three Yggdrasilberries...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我這裡......
......只有三枚世界樹果實......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I will give you these but they won't be enough...
Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我把這些給你，但數量還不夠......
外面有一棵巨樹，世界樹的根在那裡露出地面......果實應該就在附近。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
有時能在那附近找到世界樹果實。
再去找幾顆帶上。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
這片區域邊緣的沼澤附近有一根巨大的樹根。
生命之樹的根就在那兒露出地面。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你應該能在那裡找到一些世界樹果實。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You will need at least 6~7 of them...
.... .. I hope she is safe..
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
至少需要6到7顆......
......希望她平安無事......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
Terra... please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
採到果實後，立刻把它們帶到薩法村莊！！！
泰拉......一定要平安。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
...Oh where is Terra...?

[Arc]
{0}!!
Terra's back!!!
She is back in one piece!
...She hasn't been saying a single word since her return, I told her to rest in Yai...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！！
泰拉回來了！！！
她平安無事地回來了！
......她回來後一直一言不發，我讓她去雅伊休息了......

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Please come by if you don't mind...
Terra's Yai.
Which is her Private Residence... It's located at the Southeast direction from here.
I would like to hear a detailed account of what happened.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
方便的話，請過來一趟......
泰拉的雅伊（她的私人住處）在這裡的東南方。
我想聽聽事情的詳細經過。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What happened....while she was gone?
I would like to hear a detailed account fn what happened...
Please go to Terra's Yai later.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她離開期間......到底發生了什麼？
我想聽聽事情的詳細經過......
請稍後去泰拉的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I really appreciate what you've done for us.
But, I'm worried about Terra.
I hope she can be her old self...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我真的很感激你為我們所做的一切。
但我擔心泰拉。
希望她能恢復從前的樣子......

scripts.text:
[Arc]

There are footprints here as well as signs that someone has fallen.
It looks like someone was fighting here?
But who?
scripts.translation:
這裡有腳印，還有人摔倒過的痕跡。
看起來有人在這裡戰鬥過？
究竟是誰？

scripts.text: There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.

scripts.text:
Someone must have had a fight here.
There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation:
有人一定在這裡戰鬥過。
有腳印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 這裡的腳印似乎通向某個地方。

scripts.text:
There's evidence that there was a fight here too.
These footsteps can't be a Laphine's...
scripts.translation:
這裡也有戰鬥過的痕跡。
這些腳印不像是拉斐族留下的......

scripts.text:
There's a stem entangled inside an opening in the roots of a huge tree...
It looks like something slipped here.
scripts.translation:
巨樹根部的縫隙裡纏著一根莖蔓......
看起來有什麼東西從這裡滑了下去。

scripts.text: A cold breeze is blowing out from deep inside the tree.
scripts.translation: 一股冷風從樹的深處吹出來。

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追蹤痕跡

scripts.text: Looks dangerous... head back.
scripts.translation: 看起來很危險......還是回去吧。

scripts.text: You take a one step forward carefully through the muddy roots and slip.
scripts.translation: 你小心地穿過泥濘的樹根，卻一腳滑倒。

scripts.text:
It's too dark to see anything inside...but it feels like there's a big hole at the bottom.
I'd better step back...It looks dangerous.
scripts.translation:
裡面太黑，什麼也看不見......但感覺底下有個大洞。
還是退後吧......看起來很危險。

scripts.text: Between huge roots, there is a hole leads to the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 巨大的樹根之間有個洞口，通往地下洞穴。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 進去看看

scripts.text: I'm not going in there.
scripts.translation: 我不進去。

scripts.text: Again, you slip through the muddy roots.
scripts.translation: 你又一次在泥濘的樹根間滑倒了。

scripts.text: You decide to come back later.
scripts.translation: 你決定稍後再來。

scripts.text:
Strange looking stems are entangled inside an opening of huge roots.
Surface looks unstable...I should step away before I slip on it.
scripts.translation:
巨大的樹根縫隙裡纏著形狀奇怪的莖蔓。
表面很滑......我最好離遠點，免得摔倒。

Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
你攜帶的物品過多。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text: This is the only spot where sunlight is shining down through a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 這是唯一有陽光透過天花板洞口照射進來的地方。

scripts.text: Looking up I see the roots of the tree and stems digging up a mud-plastered wall, so the sunlight could shine through....2.j...There is a statue of Giant on the ground.
scripts.translation:
抬頭望去，樹根和莖蔓穿透了覆泥的牆壁，讓陽光照了進來......
地上有一尊巨人雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A statue in a place like this...
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這種地方居然有一尊雕像......
真有意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm, This resembles... that giant tribe in Manuk...
Huh? It's wearing a muffler...
...It can't be!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這看起來像......馬努克的巨人部族......
咦？它還戴著圍巾......
......不會吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot of scars on it... as if it had been in a severe fight...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它身上有很多傷疤......看起來經歷過一場惡戰......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And it appears like it's holding something in its arms...
Just what happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它似乎還抱著什麼東西......
這裡到底發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't imagine what happened here, but I don't see Terra's marks anymore...
and this cave looks unsafe... I'd better go back to Arc for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不清楚這裡發生了什麼，但已經看不到泰拉留下的標記了......
洞穴看起來也不安全......我先回去找阿克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could it be... Terra was fighting this Giant?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道......泰拉和這個巨人戰鬥過？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways... How do I get out of here?
That hole I came in is too slippery to climb back out...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管怎樣......我怎麼出去？
進來的洞太滑了，爬不上去......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Light is coming in from the ceiling above... Maybe I should just climb a stem around here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
上方天花板的洞口透進了光......也許可以沿著附近的莖蔓爬上去......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm done with this place.
I should go back to Arc...
Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受夠這裡了。
得回去找阿克......
先找出口吧。

scripts.text:
I came back here, but there's no trace of Terra...
There's only one thing different from the last time..Small particles of an ore are sprinkled around the Sapha's dead body.
scripts.translation:
我又回到這裡，卻沒看見泰拉的蹤跡......
唯一不同的是，薩法屍體周圍散落著一些礦石粉末。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...Terra was here.....
Powdered Bradium...
What was she trying to do with this Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以......泰拉來過這裡......
布拉迪姆粉末......
她想對這名薩法做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't just go back to Arc without anything... he'd be so disappointed...
Hmm, Should I go to the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不能空手回去......阿克會很失望......
嗯，要不要去薩法村莊看看？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

One thing that bugs me is...These particles of an ore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我再也找不到泰拉留下的蹤跡了。
只有這些礦石粉末讓我在意......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go back to Arc and ask about it, or go to Sapha's Village and investigate some more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我該回去問阿克這是什麼，還是去薩法村莊繼續調查？

It looks like it's dead...
scripts.translation:
這裡有一名石化的薩法族巨人。
看起來已經死了......

scripts.text:
I need to bring back some evidence of this giant in the cave.
What should I bring with me?
scripts.translation:
我得帶些洞穴裡這名巨人的東西回去作證。
該拿什麼呢？

scripts.text: Hair
scripts.translation: 頭髮

scripts.text: Muffler
scripts.translation: 圍巾

scripts.text: Pants
scripts.translation: 褲子

scripts.text: Fragment of Bradium
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆碎片

scripts.text: It won't come off. It's as if it is a tree rooted on a rock.
scripts.translation: 拔不下來，就像樹紮根在岩石上一樣。

scripts.text:
You carefully strip a worn muffler off of the Sapha's neck.
We will see if this muffler belongs to Ogen or not.
scripts.translation:
你小心地從薩法族脖子上取下一條磨損的圍巾。
回去確認這是不是奧根的圍巾。

scripts.text: And...what else should I take?

Now I have the muffler, let's go back to Luik and Snorren.
scripts.translation:
石化的薩法族巨人。
現在拿到了圍巾，回去找盧伊克和斯諾倫吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen!!!!!!
...Ogen... Ogen...
....Ogeeen......
You don't mean..?
scripts.translation: 你的意思是...？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This.. is.. worse than I could have imagined.....
Ogen... this doesn't look like it can be reversed...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
這......比我想像的還要糟......
奧根......看來已經無法恢復原狀了......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
No matter how much bradium fluid we inject... Ogen can't come back alive...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
不管注射多少布拉迪姆溶液......奧根都沒法活過來......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... really was adament... about protecting that Laphine... to protect Terra.....
He did his best 'til the last...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
奧根......真的很執著......為了保護拉斐族......為了保護泰拉......
直到最後一刻......他都盡了全力。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Look at this, {0}...
His petrifyied body...
protected Terra...like this.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
看看這個，{0}......
他石化的身體......
就這樣保護著泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... made himself an unbreakable shield...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
奧根......把自己變成了一面堅不可摧的盾......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... you can now go back to the bosom of the Motherland...
This statue will be a monument to your courage...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
奧根......你現在可以迴歸祖國的懷抱了......
這座雕像會成為你英勇的紀念......

scripts.text: - - I can't begin to describe the sorrow of losing a close friend... -
scripts.translation: - 失去摯友的悲痛......難以言表...... -

scripts.text: - All I could do was to keep tapping his shoulder... as he quietly sobbed... -
scripts.translation: - 我只能輕拍他的肩膀......看著他默默哭泣...... -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's.. go back...
Ogen wouldn't want you to be so sad and depressed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們......回去吧......
奧根不會希望你這麼悲傷消沉。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I guess you are right...
There's... sunlight shining here...
This... must be a comfort resting place for Ogen.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你說得對......
這裡有陽光照耀......
這一定是奧根安息的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I should go and tell Luik and the townspeople about this...
I will go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我得去把這件事告訴盧伊克和鎮上的居民......
我先走了。

scripts.text:
- Snorren stood up with a bitter smile...
...I should go back too... I'm worried about Terra. -
scripts.translation:
- 斯諾倫帶著苦澀的笑容站起身......
......我也該回去了......我很擔心泰拉。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, I almost forgot the ring.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀，差點忘了戒指。

scripts.text:
Ogen... was petrified as he covered Terra...
What was going on between them that they would see past their racial differences...?
scripts.translation:
奧根......石化時正護著泰拉......
他們之間究竟發生了什麼，竟能超越種族隔閡......？

scripts.text: Before you is a statue made of stone and wood. It's so life-like it's eerie.
scripts.translation: 眼前是一座由石頭和木頭製成的雕像。栩栩如生，令人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
The trunk of a Tree moderately stretched upward.
There are big thorns here that should be enough to use as footholds to climb up.
scripts.translation:
樹幹向上延伸。
上面長著粗大的荊棘，可以當作落腳點攀爬。

scripts.text:
It's the trunk of a Tree stretched out toward a hole in the ceiling.
Big thorns can be used as footholds.
scripts.translation:
樹幹一直伸向天花板的洞口。
粗大的荊棘可以當作落腳點。

scripts.text: Climb up.
scripts.translation: 爬上去

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
By the way, how did that Fairy come this far?
Is she captured?
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
對了，那個妖精怎麼會跑到這麼遠的地方？
她被抓來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No, She's not.
That Fairy came here by her own accord.
How impudent. She was horribly wounded when she got here.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
不是，她是自己來的。
真大膽。她來的時候傷得很重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmm? a Fairy? Wounded?
Are they talking about Terra..?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（嗯？妖精？受傷？
他們說的是泰拉......？！）

scripts.text: Break into their conversation.
scripts.translation: 打斷他們的談話

scripts.text: Keep quiet and listen.
scripts.translation: 保持安靜，繼續偷聽

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me for interrupting your conversation.
You were talking about a Fairy, would you be kind to tell me the details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉打擾你們。
你們剛才提到了一個妖精，能告訴我詳情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
Outsider!!
Why is he here?
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
外來者？！
他為什麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
We weren't saying anything.
There's nothing to tell you.
Lawine, Come with me to the Refinery later.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
我們什麼也沒說。
沒什麼好告訴你的。
拉維內，稍後和我去精煉廠。

scripts.text:
- The Sapha people are not willing to tell you anything. But the
captured Fairy may be Terra. -
scripts.translation: - 薩法族不願透露任何資訊。但那個被抓的妖精可能是泰拉。 -

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
I heard a fairy was crying and begging, she was badly hurt.
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
我聽見一個妖精在哭喊求救，她傷得很重。

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No one understand the words of fairy...
In the end we had no idea what to do.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
沒人聽得懂妖精的話......
最後我們也不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:

Anyway, that fairy is now in prison.
By the way, pull within feather
Today we have to go to the refinery,
do not forget.

scripts.text:

You know, right?
Ahh! A foreign visitor!
scripts.translation:

啊！是個外國遊客！

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
Nevermind him, he can not understand our words.

scripts.text:

scripts.translation: - 幸好薩法族以為我聽不懂他們的話，但他們一定是在談泰拉...... -

scripts.text: - The Sapha are having a conversation and not paying attention to my movements. -
scripts.translation: - 薩法族正在交談，沒有注意到我的動作。 -

scripts.translation: - 他們主要談論的是城鎮瑣事，沒什麼有用的資訊。 -

scripts.text: - I'd better move away from them before they get suspicious of my presence. -

...Outsider?
Do you have a permission to come into our village?

scripts.translation:

......外來者？
我們什麼時候允許外人來參觀了？

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
By the way, how did that Fairy come this far?
Is she captured?
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
順便問一下，那個妖精是怎麼跑到這麼遠的？
她被抓來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No, She's not.
That Fairy came here by her own accord.
How impudent. She was horribly wounded when she got here.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
不，不是。
那個妖精是自己來的。
真大膽。她來的時候傷得很重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmm? a Fairy? Wounded?
Are they talking about Terra..?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（嗯？妖精？受傷了？
他們說的是泰拉......？！）

scripts.text: Break into their conversation.
scripts.translation: 打斷他們的談話

scripts.text: Keep quiet and listen.
scripts.translation: 保持安靜，繼續偷聽

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me for interrupting your conversation.
You were talking about a Fairy, would you be kind to tell me the details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉打擾你們。
你們剛才提到了一個妖精，能告訴我詳情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
Outsider!!
Why is he here?
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
外來者？！
他為什麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
We weren't saying anything.
There's nothing to tell you.
Lawine, Come with me to the Refinery later.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
我們什麼也沒說。
沒什麼好告訴你的。
拉維內，稍後跟我一起去精煉廠。

scripts.text:
- The Sapha people are not willing to tell you anything. But the
captured Fairy may be Terra. -
scripts.translation: - 薩法族不願告訴你任何事。但那個被抓的妖精可能是泰拉。 -

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
I heard a fairy was crying and begging, she was badly hurt.
scripts.translation:
[村民拉維內]
我聽到一個妖精在哭喊求救，她傷得很重。

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No one understand the words of fairy...
In the end we had no idea what to do.
scripts.translation:
[村民裡維埃]
沒人聽得懂妖精的話......
最後我們也不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
Anyway, that fairy is now in prison.
By the way, pull within feather
Today we have to go to the refinery,
do not forget.

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...Outsider, huh...
Since when did we allow outsiders to come and visit?
That's right..Do you even understand me?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
......外來者啊......
我們什麼時候允許外人來參觀了？
沒錯......你聽得懂我說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...I guess it doesn't matter....
Ah, Do we even understand each other?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
......我想這也無所謂......
啊，我們彼此聽得懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Fsd a idh as?
Nsf iu ai sd a sd!

scripts.translation:
[村民]

Asd fo sdj fso df.

無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text:
He seems anxious as he wanders back and forth..
Is he the guard of this prison?
scripts.translation:
他焦慮地來回踱步......
他是監獄的衛兵嗎？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
.. Argh.. Why not?!
What a blockhead...
Hmm?
Who are you?!
How could an outsider be here...?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
......啊......為什麼不行？！
真是個木頭腦袋......
嗯？
你是誰？！
外來者怎麼會在這裡......？

scripts.text: About the Captured Fairy.
scripts.translation: 詢問被抓的妖精

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 這是什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
How does an outsider like you know that?
And..? What? How can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你這樣的外來者怎麼知道這件事？
還有......什麼？你怎麼聽得懂我說話？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Helloo...?
Can you understand the words coming out of my mouth?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
喂......
你聽得懂我的話嗎？

scripts.text: - I show the ring to Snorren. -
scripts.translation: - 我向斯諾倫展示戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Aha! Now I understand...
That's amazing. a ring capable of interpreting between different languages... and you were able to come all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
啊哈！我明白了......
這枚戒指竟然能翻譯不同語言，真不可思議。難怪你能一路來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I heard there are outsiders helping our people.
You must be one of them!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我聽說有外來者在幫助我們的族人。
你一定就是其中之一！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
But where did you hear about that Fairy?
Frankly, I want to have a word with that Fairy.
But I don't understand their language.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
不過，你從哪聽說那個妖精的？
說實話，我想和她——那個拉斐族——談談。
但我聽不懂她們的語言。

scripts.text: Why do you want to talk to her?
scripts.translation: 你想和她談什麼？

scripts.text: Do you need an interpreter?
scripts.translation: 你需要翻譯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
An interpreter? Certainly!
But I can't just do it arbitrarily...
The reason why I want to have a word with that fairy, I mean Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
翻譯？當然需要！
不過我不能擅自做主......
我想和那個妖精，也就是拉斐族談談，是因為......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I... want to find out if she's got anything to do with my friend...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我......想知道她是否和我的朋友......有關......

scripts.text: Your friend?
scripts.translation: 你的朋友？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah. Ogen is missing.
He said he was curious about the area you are living in and went to check it out. How foolish of him.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
是的。奧根失蹤了。
他說對你們居住的地方很好奇，就去查看了。真是傻。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
And he never came back.
After quite a while, that fairy came.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
然後他就再也沒有回來。
過了很久之後，那個妖精出現了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I don't know what guts she had to just fly into our territory.
That fairy just kept on yelling 'a bradium!' 'a bradium!'
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我真不知道她哪來的膽子，竟敢直接飛進我們的領地。
那個妖精一直喊著“布拉迪姆！布拉迪姆！”

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Our village's vigilantes are saying that fairy is affected by the power of bradium and went crazy.
That's what Laphine are all like!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
村裡的巡邏隊說，那個妖精受到布拉迪姆的力量影響，發瘋了。
拉斐族都是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
They just try to make accesories out of the ore which is our source of life.
They collect anything that possesses magical power.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
她們只想用這種作為我們生命之源的礦石做飾品。
凡是有魔力的東西，她們都收集。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should calm down a bit... Tell me about that captured Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你先冷靜一點......告訴我那個被抓的拉斐族的事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Right, I'm sorry.
Anyways, shortly after Ogen went missing the fairy appears... this is too suspicious...
and that fairy was severely wounded too.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
好吧，抱歉。
奧根失蹤後不久，那個妖精就出現了......實在可疑......
而且她傷得很重。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I think...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我想...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
That fairy attacked Ogen as he was trying to peek on your camp.
And she was drawn by Ogen's bradium and came all the way here to find more bradium!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我想......
那個妖精在奧根窺探你們營地時襲擊了他。
她被奧根身上的布拉迪姆吸引，一路來到這裡尋找更多布拉迪姆！

scripts.text: That could be right...
scripts.translation: 也許是這樣...

scripts.text: I don't see it that way...
scripts.translation: 我不這麼認為...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But does that Ore called bradium really possess an overwhelming magical power?
It didn't seem like that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是，那種叫布拉迪姆的礦石真有那麼強的魔力嗎？
看起來不像......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
This war with the Laphine... is to protect the bradium from them...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
真的嗎？可我們薩法族離不開布拉迪姆。
我們與拉斐族開戰......就是為了保護布拉迪姆不被她們奪走......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see...
Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了......
你們兩族正在為布拉迪姆而戰......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is... Is that so?
Then how do you see this situation?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
是......是這樣嗎？
那你如何看待這種局勢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just occurred to me...
It's like some kind of forbidden area...

[{0}]
Anyhow, You are going to ask that fairy about Ogen, right?
If that's the case, I could interpret between you two...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，你打算問那個妖精奧根的事，對吧？
如果是這樣，我可以幫你們翻譯......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah?!
Then just wait here for a sec!
I will go and ask Luik about this!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
是嗎？！
那你在這兒等一下！
我去問問盧伊克！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh, Ah~!
This is a prison.
You need to obey the rules to keep a peaceful group life.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
呃，啊～！
這裡是監獄。
為了維持群體生活的秩序，你得遵守規則。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This is where people who break the rules are kept overnight.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
這裡是關押違規者過夜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Oh. I'm not one of them.
I just have some business here.
Snorren is a good Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
哦，我不是囚犯。
我只是來辦點事。
斯諾倫是個好薩法人。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Umm.. Hold on a sec...
Luik. It's me. Snorren.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
嗯......等一下......
盧伊克，是我，斯諾倫。

scripts.text:
[Voice through the door]
Ah, I told you it's not possible Snorren!
I can only put you in a cell for one night!
scripts.translation:
[門後傳來的聲音]
啊，我說過不行，斯諾倫！
我只能讓你在牢房裡待一晚！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yikes-! Luik, It's not that!
I brought someone who would interpret that fairy's words!
till, Can't I come in?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
哎呀！盧伊克，不是那回事！
我帶了個能翻譯妖精語言的人來！
那麼，我能進去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Shut up! Anyway, we have more things to worry about. This Laphine, we need to treat her wounds...
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克的聲音]
閉嘴！總之，我們還有很多事要擔心。這個拉斐族得先治傷......

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation:
[盧伊克的聲音]
她的身體和我們完全不同。該怎麼辦？
嘿，斯諾倫！給我拿點東西來，什麼草藥之類的！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Herbs? Is her condition that bad?
Can't we fix her with bradium?
Oh right, She's not Sapha, ey?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
草藥？她情況這麼嚴重嗎？
不能用布拉迪姆治療嗎？
哦對，她不是薩法族，對吧？

scripts.text: Nothing gets past you...
scripts.translation: 什麼都瞞不過你......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Do you have anything on your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你有什麼心事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's a Laphine, right? Then we should ask a Laphine about it...
Like what we need to treat her...
I can take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她是拉斐族，對吧？那我們該問問她們該怎麼治療......
比如需要什麼藥。
我來想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really?
Then hurry up and bring something back...
We will wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
真的嗎？
那就快點帶點東西回來......
我們在這裡等。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I think I have no choice but to go back and ask Arc....)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（看來我只能回去問阿克了......）

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Hurry up and go find a way to cure this Laphine...
Then Luik might let us in.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
快點想辦法治好這個拉斐族......
那樣盧伊克可能就會讓我們進去。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Did you find a cure?
This.. is one strange looking fruit.
I saw this fruit from time to time, but never thought this would be a cure..?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你找到療法了嗎？
這......看起來是種奇怪的果實。
我偶爾見過它，沒想到竟能治病......？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I will take everything you've brought with you!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我會收下你帶來的所有東西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Now, Let's go inside!
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
現在，我們進去吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...this won't be enough....
I would need at least 6~7 of these...

[Snorren]
Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Ah, I think we would need more than what I've brought here... I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？哦，我帶來的可能不夠......我再去拿。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I already told Luik everything about you...
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我已經把關於你的事告訴盧伊克了......
我們進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I've been waiting for you...
Let's make haste.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我一直在等你......
我們快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I'm really confused now...Should I believe your story or not.
If it is true that cave really exists and Ogen is hurt...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我現在很困惑......該不該相信你的話。
如果那個洞穴真的存在，而且奧根受傷了......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
The approximate location is...
Huge Roots of a tree. Got it.
You go ahead first. I will stop by at a refinery and be right after you.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
大概位置是......
巨大的樹根。明白了。
你先過去，我去趟精煉廠，隨後就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Since that place is Laphine's territory, I will go quitely so they won't notice me.
You just go on ahead, I will be right behind you.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
那裡是拉斐族的領地，我會悄悄過去，免得被發現。
你先走，我馬上跟上。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
You are back. .. Luik wanted me to tell you this...
Terra, that Laphine, is free now.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
你回來了......盧伊克讓我告訴你......
那個拉斐族泰拉已經自由了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
We are tired of fighting. We didn't even want to start...
And we saw her true intention before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我們厭倦了戰鬥，一開始甚至就不想打......
而且我們看到了她的真實意圖。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Go and check if Terra went back to her home safely...
Ogen... He went back to Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
去看看泰拉是否平安回家......
奧根......他迴歸了大自然。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I really don't think what Ogen did was the right thing to do...
But that was... Ogen...
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]
我真不覺得奧根做得對......
但那就是......奧根......

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Forgive me, I'm a bit depressed...
I'd rather just rest here.
I really appreciate what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[斯諾倫]

Outside of the Expedition Camp, There's a race who uses a mysterious language which is not used in Midgard
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
遠征營地外生活著一種生物，它們使用米德加爾特沒有的神秘語言。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
We don't know if they are friend or foe, one thing for sure is it will be more easier for our research here.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我們不知道它們是敵是友，但如果能弄清楚，對我們在這裡的研究肯定更有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
So, the Triple Alliance Research Group is working together to find out. I would like to know how far the ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000's decoding process is. Would you go and find out for me?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
三方聯盟研究小組正在合作調查。我想知道^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000的破譯進度。你能替我打聽一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Go to a big building in center of the Expedition Camp and inside that building, meet ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000 and ask him how far his progress is.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
去遠征營地中央的大樓，在裡面找^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000問問進展。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
The ^0000ff Arunafeltz Linguist^000000 should be on the second floor of the Alliance Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
^0000ff阿魯納菲茲語學家^000000應該在聯盟總部二樓。

scripts.text: - He's making a grim face at a flooding pile of research documents. -
scripts.translation: - 他愁眉苦臉地看著堆積如山的研究資料。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Ah, You are here.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
啊，你來了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
t seems like you've done much for us. I thank you for that.
But...Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
看來你為我們做了不少事，謝謝你。
不過...唉...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Can you see this? The amount of these research documents?
It is a good thing that we finally decoded the other world's language... it's just too much.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你看這些研究資料，數量多得驚人。
終於破譯了異世界的語言，確實是好事...就是資料實在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
We can't always accompany a Linguist for an interpretion... We need to communicate with those other world races in order to explore this world...
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我們不能總讓語學家陪著翻譯...要探索這個世界，就得和異世界的種族交流...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
To store this amount of information will need a super computer the size of this headquarter building and its processing speed will be very very slow.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
要存下這麼多資料，需要一臺和總部大樓一樣大的超級計算機，而且處理速度還會很慢。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh... Anyways, If there's any way to store an enormous amount of data, I should be able to make a very-small portable translator.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
唉...總之，要是能找到儲存海量資料的方法，我就能造出一臺小巧的便攜翻譯器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I heard that by using a Magical Spell of Rune-Midgarts, you can transpose data to a magical power and lock it into a gem... I'd like some suggestions from the Rune-Midgarts Magician.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我聽說盧恩·米德加茲王國的魔法能把資料轉化為魔力，封存在寶石裡...我想聽聽王國魔法師的建議。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Would you be kind to ask them for help?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
能請你去問問他們，幫忙想想辦法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
While you are gone, I be here organizing these documents.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你去的時候，我會留在這裡整理這些資料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
To store this amount of information will need a super computer with a size of this headquarter building. and its processing speed will be very very slow...
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
要存下這麼多資料，需要一臺和總部大樓一樣大的超級計算機，處理速度還會很慢...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh... Anyways, If there's any way to store an enormous amount of data, I could be able to make a very-small portable translator.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
唉...總之，要是能找到儲存海量資料的方法，我就能造出一臺小巧的便攜翻譯器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I heard that by using the Magical Spell of Rune-Midgarts, you could transpose a data to a magical power and lock it into a gem....I'd like to get some suggestion from the Magician of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我聽說盧恩·米德加茲王國的魔法能把資料轉化為魔力，再封存在寶石裡...我想聽聽王國魔法師的建議。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Would you be kind to ask them for help?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
能請你去問問他們，幫忙想想辦法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
While you are gone, I be here organizing these documents.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你去的時候，我會留在這裡整理這些資料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
How'd it go?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Give him the Gem.
scripts.translation: 交給他寶石。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Ah, Looks like you've succeeded.
Inputting data into a gem with a magical power... It's something you can't do with a technology... It's a bit resentful to admit, but it's magnificent.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
啊，看來你辦成了。
把資料輸入蘊含魔力的寶石...這是科技做不到的事...雖然不太甘心承認，但真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well then, I should be working on making a machine to read the magical data in this Gem so we could use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
那麼，我得造一臺能讀取寶石中魔法資料的機器，這樣我們就能馬上使用這些資料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Fortunately, It won't be as hard as we thought.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
嗯...
幸好這不會像我們想的那麼難。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
If we transform a magical power wave to an eletric signal and connect it to a human body, then transmit a data to a brain directly. That will allow us to receive and understand a data without any loading process.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
如果把魔力波轉換成電訊號並連線到人體，再把資料直接傳入大腦，就能不經載入，直接接收並理解資料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't have time to explain everything. I have to start the work right away.
With all preperation done, allow me about one hour to finish this thing.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我沒時間解釋所有細節，得馬上動手。
準備工作都做好後，再給我一個小時左右完成它。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh, What should I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
唉，我現在該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
- Dorance is walking here and there -
- in a dither. -
scripts.translation: - 多蘭斯焦躁不安地來回踱步。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is something wrong?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出什麼事了？！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
What should I do?! Ain't I REALLY a genius?!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我該怎麼辦？！我難道不是個真正的天才嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I've made it!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
我成功了！！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Convenient portable size!
Fashionable and practical design!
Features the Other World's Words / Idiom / Grammer / Phrases!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
小巧便攜！
時尚實用！
收錄異世界詞彙、成語、語法和短語！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Have you experienced the loading speed?
Don't you even mention it if you haven't.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你體驗過它的載入速度嗎？
沒體驗過就別提了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
That's not all!
For the Well-Being life, it will buff your strength and intelligence!!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
還不止這些！
為了健康生活，它還能提升力量和智力！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
With all these marvelous features, it's just 39,900 zeny....!!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
這麼多神奇功能，只要39,900 Zeny...！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Just what are you trying to imitate...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...你這到底是在模仿什麼...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Important thing is, I've made it!!
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
重要的是，我把它做出來了！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well, Seeing is believing.
Take a look.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
眼見為實。
來看看吧。

scripts.text: - He handed over the small ring. -
scripts.translation: - 他遞給我一枚小戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
The name is 'the Ring of Wise King'. I designed it after the Ring used by ancient king to communicate with animals.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
它叫“睿智之王戒指”。我參照古代國王用來和動物交流的戒指設計了它。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Do not just look at it like any other rings. You see this small gem here? This socket which holds a gem and a ring part are precisely crafted, it will transform a magical power wave to electric signal and trasmit it directly to our brain.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
別把它當成普通戒指。看到這顆小寶石了嗎？鑲嵌寶石的底座和戒指本體都經過精密設計，能將魔力波轉換成電訊號，直接傳入大腦。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Since this electric signal is same as the signal used by our body's nerve system, it will enable us to understand and use the language fluently.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
這種電訊號與人體神經系統使用的訊號相同，因此戴上它就能流利地理解和使用語言。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Once this translator gets popularized, it'd be just a matter of time for us to advance into the other world. Well, the problem is...we don't have enough quantity yet...
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
這種翻譯器一旦普及，我們進入異世界就只是時間問題了。問題是...目前數量還不夠...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Anyways, now we've got the idea, I will give you this first piece of work.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
嗯...
總之，既然有了這個想法，我就把第一件成品送給你吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Thank you for helping us out.
I hope this ring would be a big help for your journey through the other world.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
謝謝你幫忙。
希望這枚戒指能助你在異世界旅途一臂之力。

scripts.text:
- He has scattered mechanical parts -
- all over the room and so wrapped up -
- in his work -
scripts.translation:
- 房間裡散落著機械零件，
- 他完全沉浸在工作中。 -

scripts.text:
- I might get bitten if I bother him -
- Let's leave him alone -
scripts.translation:
- 打擾他可能會被咬...
- 還是別管他了。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I hope this ring would be a big help for your journey through the other world.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
希望這枚戒指能助你在異世界旅途一臂之力。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Do you know about the Ring of Ancient Wise King? If you wear that Ring, you could talk to an animal.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你聽說過古代睿智之王戒指嗎？戴上它就能和動物交談。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't know if it is a legend based on a truth or not... something like that will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
不知道這究竟是傳說還是事實...不過那樣的東西肯定很有用。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
By the way, Who are you? This building is under Commander's control. This place is not to be entered freely... Are you acquainted with our Commander?
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
對了，你是誰？這棟建築由指揮官管轄，不是誰都能隨便進來的...你認識我們的指揮官嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Are you looking for something to do? Perhaps I could use some help... Well, I don't know if you are trustworthy just yet.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
你在找事情做嗎？也許我有事需要幫忙...不過我還不確定你是否值得信任。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
If you are good enough to solve some problems within the expedition camp, and carry out a mission given by Commander... then I think I could trust you.
scripts.translation:
[機械工程師多蘭斯]
如果你能解決遠征營地裡的問題，並完成指揮官交給你的任務...我想我就能信任你了。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language distinguishes humans from animals. Every single intellectual life form has their own language.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言是人類區別於動物的特徵。每一種智慧生命都有自己的語言。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language is a method / system which delievers one's feeling or thinking by voice or letters. Anyway, its purpose is to communicate.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言是一套通過聲音或文字傳達情感和思想的系統。說到底，它的目的就是交流。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Difference between a language and a sound is that language is a socially implied promise by making common system of communication to make it possible to understand eachother.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言和聲音的區別在於：語言是一種社會約定，藉助共同的交流體系，人們才能彼此理解。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
That Socially implied promise, if we could grasp the meaning of a system and structure, we will be able to understand other intellectual life form's language...
...................................And just who might you be?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
如果能掌握這種社會約定背後的體系和結構，我們就能理解其他智慧生命的語言...
...................................你又是誰？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
This is a restricted place under control of our Commander. No one could enter here without proper approval... Are you acquainted with our Commander?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
這裡是指揮官管轄的限制區域。未經許可，任何人都不能進入...你認識我們的指揮官嗎？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language is a distinctive feature of human race compared to animals. Every single intellectual life form has their own language.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言是人類區別於動物的顯著特徵。每一種智慧生命都有自己的語言。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language is a method / system which delievers one's feeling or thinking by voice or letters. Anyway, its purpose is to communicate.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言是一套通過聲音或文字傳達情感和思想的系統。說到底，它的目的就是交流。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Difference between a language and a sound is that language is a socially implied promise by making common system of communication to make it possible to understand eachother.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
語言和聲音的區別在於：語言是一種社會約定，藉助共同的交流體系，人們才能彼此理解。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
That Socially implied promise, if we could grasp the meaning of a system and structure, we will be able to understand other intellectual life form's language...
...................................And just who might you be?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
如果能掌握這種社會約定背後的體系和結構，我們就能理解其他智慧生命的語言...
...................................你又是誰？

scripts.text: I am Me!
scripts.translation: 我就是我！

scripts.text: I don't have a name to tell you!
scripts.translation: 我沒法告訴你我的名字！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
What the heck?
If you are so bored, why don't you go fishing?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
搞什麼啊？
這麼無聊的話，為什麼不去釣魚？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Ah~ I've heard from our Commander about you. You've done much for the Midgard Alliance Camp. Anyways, what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
啊~我聽指揮官提起過你。你為米德加爾特聯盟營地做了很多事。對了，你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text: I thought I had confused you a bit...
scripts.translation: 我還以為能讓你困惑一下呢...

scripts.text: What were you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Confusion is a feeling that comes from distraction of one's mind when something that couldn't be predicted happens. I'm not a person who easily gets confused.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
所謂困惑，就是發生意料之外的事時，思緒受到干擾而產生的感覺。我可不是那麼容易困惑的人。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
I'm a linguist from Arunafeltz. I'm a scholor who studies a system and a structure of every kinds of language in the world.
And...don't you think the reason man like me is here is that there's a predictable cause?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
我是來自阿魯納菲茲的語學家，研究世上各種語言的體系和結構。
而且...你不覺得我會出現在這裡，必然有其原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
From what I heard, you've done much for the Midgard Alliance Research Group.
And while you were helping us, I believe you've seen and visited many places here in the other world.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
據我所知，你為米德加爾特聯盟研究組做了很多事。
在幫助我們的過程中，你應該也遊歷過異世界的許多地方。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Have you met the other world's people by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
你有沒有遇到過異世界的居民？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Looks like you haven't encountered them yet.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
看來你還沒遇到他們。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Rumor here says that there's a fairy-looking and a giant wood people living out in the fields next to our camp here.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
聽說營地旁的原野上住著像妖精一樣的族群，以及高大的木人。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Apparently these people are speaking in a strange languages that we humans can't understand...but no one seems to be able to remember how their languages sound like.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
據說他們說著人類聽不懂的奇怪語言...但似乎沒人記得那些語言聽起來是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
A NEW language!! This is an exciting discovery for a linguist like myself, but as you know, there's dangerous monsters outside... It's not possible for a mere scholor to go out wandering around.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
新語言！！對我這樣的語學家來說，這可是令人興奮的發現。但外面有危險的魔物...普通學者不可能獨自出去閒逛。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
I've said this much, I think you'd be able to guess what I'm going to ask you to do.
scripts.translation:
[語學家字典]
我說到這裡，你應該能猜到我要拜託你做什麼了吧。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]

[救生員博士]
看起來你帶的東西太多了。
不如先把一些物品存進倉庫，再回來吧？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
薩法族的未來掌握在你手中。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I do not have any need of your help right now.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
薩法族的未來就託付給你了。
眼下我不需要你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I don't know if it's caused by the cold weather or our chronic disease getting worse.
It hasn't been too long since we administered the Bradium, so why.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我不知道這是天氣寒冷造成的，還是我們的慢性病加重了。
我們才剛注射過布拉迪姆，怎麼會這樣？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Huu... You see, we are afraid of such things... What a hard life.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
唉...你看，我們害怕的就是這種事...日子真難熬。

scripts.text: A chronic disease?
scripts.translation: 慢性病？

scripts.text: Bradium?
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
We Sapha, who are descendants of Hwergelmir, survived and rebuilt the Giant tribe in the flood of the blood of Ymir.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我們薩法是赫瓦格密爾的後裔，在依美樂之血的洪流中倖存下來，並重建了巨人部族。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
For no apparent reason, we developed a chronic disease that makes our bodies dry and harden over time just like an old tree.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
不知為何，我們患上了一種慢性病，身體會像老樹一樣逐漸乾枯、硬化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I think that this is the curse of Ymir who bled by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我想，這是被眾神放血的依美樂施下的詛咒吧？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But we couldn't just wait for death to slowly creep up on us and exterminate our entire race.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
但我們不能坐以待斃，任由死亡慢慢逼近，最終滅絕整個族群。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
To heal this rare disease the smartest Sapha studied and studied.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
為了治癒這種罕見疾病，薩法族最聰明的人反覆進行了研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
What they found was that by injecting a refined Bradium, which is buried around Jotunheim, it can postpone the progression of the disease.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
他們發現，注射約頓海姆周邊開採的精煉布拉迪姆，可以延緩病情惡化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
So all of the giants of Sapha established their towns around mines to get Bradium easier.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
因此，薩法巨人在礦脈周圍建立城鎮，以便更容易取得布拉迪姆。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It seems the amount of buried Bradium is enough.
But for the eternal prosperity of our tribe, and to make the vaccine for this incurable disease, we have to study more and more.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
目前埋藏的布拉迪姆似乎還夠用。
但為了讓族群長久繁榮，也為了研製治療這種不治之症的疫苗，我們必須繼續深入研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Bradium is the stem of our life.
But the buried Bradium will be exhausted someday, so we Scientists have to find an alternative for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
布拉迪姆是我們的生命之源。
但埋藏的布拉迪姆終有一天會耗盡，所以我們科學家必須為後代找到替代品。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, we've learned that there are various minerals in the human world Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
最近，我們得知人類世界米德加爾特擁有各種各樣的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Now the world called Midgard is
like a holy place for us,
which can bring the wind of
revolution for us.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
如今，米德加爾特對我們而言宛如聖地，
能為我們帶來變革的契機。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Contact with Midgard
must be the lead of Hwergelmir
for us, the Sapha which has such
a closed-off society.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
對於我們這樣封閉的薩法族社會而言，
與米德加爾特接觸一定是赫瓦格密爾的指引。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll draw a result that can
satisfy his lead!
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
我一定要取得符合這份指引的成果！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I can't say for sure until now,
but this mineral seems to have
many interesting features.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
目前我還不能確定，
但這種礦石似乎有許多有趣的特性。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
As I examine this mineral
more and more, it's really
different from the one in Jotunheim.
This mineral must be helpful
to make a new vaccine!
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
越研究這種礦石，我越發現它和約頓海姆的礦石截然不同。
它一定能幫助我們研製新疫苗！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But the amount of the mineral
is too little to make a
preparation for the
examination.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
但礦石數量太少，
還不夠用於檢驗。

[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll give you this portable toolbox.
Things like a detector and a little hammer for mining minerals are included in this toolbox.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
這個便攜工具箱給你。
裡面有探測器和採礦用的小錘子。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Take it, it shold be
helpful in collecting
the minerals I need.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
拿著吧，應該能幫你採集我需要的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I really appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
非常感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
These are coins of the Manuk.
This may not be much, but if you collect more, they can be used to buy some items from our merchants.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
這些是馬努克的硬幣。
雖然不多，但攢起來可以向我們的商人購買物品。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
If you want to help my study for the sake of the Sapha, come to me at any time.
I will be very happy for any help you can give.
scripts.translation:
[救生員博士]
如果你願意幫助我研究薩法族的未來，隨時都可以來找我。
有你的幫助，我會非常高興。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
看起來你帶的東西太多了。
先把一些物品存進倉庫再回來吧？

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I've heard that some strangers from Midgard are around here, it must be you.
I'm Grenouille, a scientist.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我聽說有些米德加爾特來的外鄉人在這附近，想必就是你們。
我是科學家格勒努伊。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It's been a long time since
the Laphine built the Splendide camp here
and confronted each other.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
拉斐族在此建立輝煌領域營地，與敵人對峙，已經很久了。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
A number of soldiers who
left their hometown Alfheim are
restraining them with fighting against
the harsh cold of Jotunheim
for the holy duty and the faith to
stop the evil attempts to
sickening Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
許多離開故鄉阿爾弗雷姆計程車兵，為履行神聖職責、阻止邪惡勢力侵害世界樹，在約頓海姆的嚴寒中奮戰。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
They're well trained soldiers,
and their captains hold them in high esteem,
so they're enjoying a
comfortable life there.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
他們訓練有素，深受長官器重，因此在那裡生活得很安逸。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
But there's a saying that
constant dripping water
wears away the stone.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
不過，水滴石穿。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Continuous small battles without big progression
makes the soldiers in Splendide exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
長期只有小規模戰鬥，又毫無進展，令輝煌領域計程車兵們疲憊不堪。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
One day, someone began to sing
a song of Alfheim, that spread rapidly...
Now they strongly
miss their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有一天，有人唱起阿爾弗雷姆的歌，很快傳遍了營地...
如今，他們非常思念故鄉。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I was so worried about them and
I finally found a way to
save them from the deep sadness.
I hope you to help me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我很擔心他們，終於想到了讓他們擺脫悲傷的辦法。
希望你能幫我。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There's a Laphine General
who is called Flowery,
in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
輝煌領域有位拉斐族將軍，人稱花兒。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
She is a collecting maniac,
so her house is always
in a mess with miscellaneous
things. Flowery must have
seeds from the flowers
of Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
她是個收藏狂，房間裡總是亂糟糟的。花兒一定收藏著阿爾弗雷姆花朵的種子。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I'll make the flower of
Alfheim open with the seed.
The flower of their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我會用種子培育出阿爾弗雷姆之花。
那是他們故鄉的花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There are some devices that purify
the environment and have a function
that can hasten the growth of plants.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有些裝置能淨化環境，還能加快植物生長。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Please bring me the flower of Alfheim that bloomed by the device.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
請帶給我一朵由裝置催開的阿爾弗雷姆之花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
The flower of Alfheim is not
strong enough to keep it's life by
depending on the Splendide device,
but ^FF0000the way^000000 can fill
Splendide by it's scent like it never falls!
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
阿爾弗雷姆之花無法僅靠輝煌領域的裝置維持生命，但^FF0000這種方法^000000能讓花香瀰漫整個輝煌領域，彷彿永不凋謝！

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Get a seed from Flowery,
and then use a Purifier
to make the seed blossom.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
從花兒那裡拿到種子，再用淨化器讓它開花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Hoo, this is one of the
most common kinds of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
呼，這只是最常見的一種花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Haha, Don't worry.
Common flowers like this can bring the familiarity of home back to the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
哈哈，別擔心。這樣的普通花朵也能讓士兵找回熟悉的家鄉氣息。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
For now, I'll extract a liquid that
includes the scent of this flower by using a distiller.
Making a ^3131FFPerfume^000000.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
現在我用蒸餾器提取花香液體，
製成^3131FF香水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Would you please wait a while?
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Where is the flower?
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]

我想把這瓶香水叫作^3131FF阿爾弗雷姆之魂^000000！

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
This perfume can relieve their minds by using
the scent of their hometown Alfheim.
Though it's not a permanent solution, I think it will help them feel comfortable for now.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
這瓶香水能用故鄉阿爾弗雷姆的氣息撫慰士兵。
雖然不是長久之計，但至少能讓他們暫時好受些。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Here, I'll give you this perfume,
help the exhausted soldiers and
let me know the result, please!
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
拿著這瓶香水去幫助疲憊計程車兵，再回來告訴我結果！

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Oh! How's the reaction of the soldiers?
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
哦！士兵們反應如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, they seemed to be happy.
But, it still made someone cry because he probably misses Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他們看起來很開心。
不過還是有人哭了，大概是太想念阿爾弗雷姆了。

scripts.translation:
